title: File:201406 Fields in Dahutong, Ninghai National Fitness Trail2.jpg
claims: A green hillside cut by a narrow farm track or trail, with rectangular fields and scrub on both sides and a wooded valley to the left; no runners, flags or timing equipment are visible. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file 201406 Fields in Dahutong, Ninghai National Fitness Trail2.jpg. The route page uses it as low-altitude field-and-trail context inside Ninghai county; it is not a photograph of the 2026 UTNH-100 course or of an aid station.

The Commons author field reads MNXANL; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the relevant date is 2014-06-14 12:23:31; the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 2,560 × 1,920 px; 1,031,993 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 720 px; 261,163 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits MNXANL, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
